mentions.name: WhatsYum
mentions.description: This platform provides ratings for individual dishes instead of just restaurants as a whole, and is developing a b2b intelligence offering for restaurants after four years in operation.
mentions.problem: The b2c side has been too hard to get off the ground without solid investment, which the author has been unable to secure.
mentions.audience: Restaurants (b2b customers of the intelligence offering).

mentions.name: Whatsyum
mentions.description: A restaurant review site that rates individual dishes instead of restaurants as a whole, helping users figure out what is actually good to order at a highly-rated place and find things like the best burger in a given area.
mentions.problem: Restaurant ratings typically cover the establishment as a whole, so it is hard to know which specific dishes are actually good.
